hero.title: Mazaaq, an Arabic space
hero.titleAccent: that inspires you to cook with love
hero.paragraphOne: Mazaaq began with a simple idea: to make everyday cooking clearer and closer to every Arabic home, with accessible content and warm language that feels like sharing a meal around the table.
hero.paragraphTwo: We create a space that brings inspiration and simplicity together. We believe great meals do not need to be complicated, just clear steps and a touch of love.
hero.featureSubtitle: From the heart to the table

programmer.title: Who is behind Mazaaq?
programmer.description: Thoughtfully designed to offer a simple, fast Arabic experience on every screen.
programmer.name: Omar Moataz Salam
programmer.bio: I developed this website using my front-end experience with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI. I also built the back end with Node.js and Express.js and connected it to MongoDB to deliver a complete experience.
